title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu helps Kanmani talk to Thenmozhi over the phone. Later, Anbu excitedly explains child growth during pregnancy to Maya and Iniyan as Kanmani listens.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: As the power cut delays Ilamathi's batter preparation, Paraman finds a way to get it ground by neighbours and relatives. When they pack it for delivery, Kalamma plots to stop it.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Mahesh's revelation proves Vetri innocent of the kidnapping charges and leads to his release. Later, Abinaya suspects Karna's involvement in Mahesh's abduction.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Pechi cooks for the family and feeds an emotional Manjamalai. Later, Azhagar and Ilavarasi share lunch after she refuses to eat without him.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Lakshmi Prepares for Her Morning Walk
description: Bagyaraj and Malar are happy over Lakshmi's change, while Suresh thanks Mathi for caring for his mother. Lakshmi eagerly awaits her morning walk, keeping her new shoes beside her.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan declines to see his baby's scan when the doctor asks him. Despite his feelings for the child, he struggles with Thangamayil's deception and refuses to forgive her.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan and Nila convince Cheran to spend the wedding night with Chandayatha. Thenmozhi is angered when Chandayatha's relative vomits outside Nila's bathroom.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu explains Chandra's plight to Meena while Sakthivel promises Manoj that Devika's property will be his. Later, Vijaya stops Rohini from going to the hospital with Manoj.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Eshwari threatens to reveal Aishwarya's secret to Sethupathi in exchange for a photo from an important file. Later, Sethupathi fumes as the file's information gets leaked.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Aadhavan panics as Vyshali agrees to marry him, shocking Pooja. After an intimate moment, Aadhavan promises Pooja to reveal their love to the family.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
episodeTitle: A Grand Welcome for the Couple
description: Hearing Sarasu's concern about having no parental home, Indhira takes her to the feast. Later, Indhira's friends give her and Murugan a grand welcome celebration.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 12: New King and Servants
description: Task disputes bring debates over fair play among the contestants. Prithvi becomes king with three servants, an eviction looms, and two members head straight to jail.
